title: Curriculum
description: A staged path from one region's accent to another's. One curriculum per file, named <from>-to-<to>.yml.

from.description: Region slug the learner starts from. Must be registered in data/regions.yml.

to.description: Region slug the learner is heading for. Must be registered, and must have an accent: file — there is nothing to teach otherwise.

intake.description: How you find out where the learner is starting from.

learn.description: Rule ids from the DESTINATION region's accent file. Checked.

unlearn.description: Rule ids from the ORIGIN region's accent file. Checked.

drill.description: Same shape as the examples: in an accent file, so they read the same way.

not_covered.description: Things a reader will expect and won't find, and why. `rule` here is a LABEL, not a checked reference — some of what belongs in this list (the urr vowel) is deliberately not a rule anywhere, which is the whole reason it needs saying.

sources.description: REQUIRED, same as everywhere else. No source, no merge.
